answer: Track shared failure, not shared success. Farms run many seats on one host, so they go dark together. The ledger logs each seat's missed heartbeats per epoch; seats whose outages coincide far beyond chance across a week are treated as one harbor and split a single reward share. Like shale, a farm cracks along one bedding plane. Honest agents on separate machines fail at random times and stay marble-solid, while a farm must pay for truly independent hosting per seat.
